ThingDef.label: glitterstim
ThingDef.description: Glitterstim is a potent variety of the drug family "spice" that is created by the Energy Spiders of Kessel. It gave the user a brief, yet pleasurable, telepathic boost and heightened mental state. It is a very valuable spice and is known to crackle and spark when ingested.

HediffDef.label: high on glitterstim
HediffDef.description: Glitterstim in the bloodstream. It enhances consciousness and increases psychic sensitivity.

li.label: high on Glitterstim
li.description: I feel euphoric. I am one with the galaxy and the galaxy is one with me.

HediffDef.label: glitterstim addiction
HediffDef.description: A chemical addiction to glitterstim. Long-term presence of glitterstim has caused neurological adaptations at the cellular level, so the brain can no longer function properly without the drug. \nWithout regular doses of glitterstim, withdrawal symptoms will begin. However, extended abstinence will force the brain to adapt back to its normal state, resolving the addiction.

HediffDef.label: glitterstim tolerance
HediffDef.description: A built-up tolerance to glitterstim. The more severe this tolerance is, the more glitterstim it takes to get the same effect.

NeedDef.label: glitterstim
NeedDef.description: Because of a glitterstim addiction, this person needs to regularly consume the drug to avoid withdrawal symptoms.
